newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Anaconda Nickel finalises mine finance.
newsitem.headline: Anaconda Nickel finalises mine finance.

text.p: Anaconda Nickel NL said on Monday it had finalised the financing structure for its 60 percent interest in the proposed Murrin Murrin nickel and cobalt mine project in Western Australia.
At 0145 GMT (11.45 a.m.), Anaconda shares were trading 20 cents higher at A$3.55 after being temporarily halted earlier on Monday pending an announcement by the company.
The financing structure involves a US$400 million U.S. capital markets Issue led by the New York investing arm of National Westminster Bank Plc (NatWest Capital Markets), it said.
The A$900 million Murrin Murrin project is located east of the outback town of Leonora in Western Australia.
Murrin Murrin is scheduled to come onstream at the end of 1998 and to reach production of 45,000 tonnes of nickel and 3,000 tonnes of cobalt in that year.
Glencore International AG of Switzerland, which has a 40 percent stake in Murrin Murrin and a 19 percent stake in Anaconda Nickel, has exclusive rights to sell the cobalt and nickel.
Anaconda has plans to expand annual production to 75,000 tonnes of nickel and 5,000 tonnes of cobalt once the base plant is commissioned.
